interpretation: The corrected controlled argv contract was observed consistently in six trials. This current evidence isolates a launcher argv0 text/canonical difference while exact count, tail, child interpreter argv, current executable identity and subsequent native selection agree.
These results do not retrospectively identify the Run27 inclusion failure or the unretained differing argument in Run29.
The workload failed before completing the required CPU/RSS/churn gate. Six complete samples at the observed partial load do not prove the intended full three-worker, 60-second condition.
The stress observations contain no unknown/retried/timeout samples; monitorFailure=null does not establish that every other stage had no recovered race.
Readiness timeout is plausible from the old workload design but unproven. Worker startup/allocation failure, early exit and other exceptions remain unclassified.
